name: cronboard
description: GNOME Shell extension for managing your cron jobs from the top panel

scripts.build: npm run check && esbuild src/extension.ts src/prefs.ts --bundle --format=esm --target=firefox115 '--external:gi://*' '--external:resource://*' --outdir=dist && cp metadata.json stylesheet.css data/cronboard-run dist/
scripts.pack: npm run build && gnome-extensions pack dist --extra-source=cronboard-run --force
